verdict.rationale: First-party docs show broad first-party support for unified telemetry: APM/agent metrics, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry ingestion, integrated log management with automatic 'logs in context' metadata tying logs to traces/APM entities, NRQL as a single query language across all data types, and dashboards/alerts that draw on all three signal types (new-relic-docs-24,30,32,33,36). This directly matches the 'collect and pivot with shared context' story. However, community reports describe logging agent bugs causing data loss, fragile in-cluster collectors, and confusing/slow UI that undercuts the smooth cross-signal experience (new-relic-comm-2, new-relic-comm-13, new-relic-comm-12), so real-world execution has notable friction. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of seamless metric-log-trace pivoting without the reported logging reliability/UI issues, and clearer first-party UX docs on the actual context-pivot workflow.
